description: The dock at one of its three layers. `app` and `user` are what tell them apart: `app` set is an app's own fragment, the base every site starts from; `user` set is that person's own arrangement, applied last and winning; neither set is the site layer, curated by a Workspace Manager and applying to everyone. An app's fragment names only its own entries -- the site and user layers span every app and name none. Same shape at all three, because the rows are identical and the parent is what says whose they are; see `Custom Sidebar`, which layers the same way.

fields.description: The app whose fragment this is. Set only on the app layer -- the site's and a person's own arrangement span every app and leave this blank.
fields.label: App

fields.description: The person whose own arrangement this is. Blank means the site layer, which applies to everyone and is overridden by each user's own.
fields.label: User

fields.description: The ordered entries this layer has an opinion about. Row order is the arrangement; an entry this layer never names keeps its incoming order and follows the ones it does, which is how a newly installed app's modules still reach someone who has already arranged their dock.
fields.label: Dock Items

name: Dock
